entries.title: Type "original" to open the article's source
entries.body: Typing "original" in the command bar offers Open the original, which opens the article where it came from, at its web address or as the PDF you uploaded, in a new tab. Before, that word found only Plain mode. The View the original button on the Metadata page appears only for uploaded PDFs, since for other uploads it led nowhere.

entries.title: Slimmer margins on every touch screen
entries.body: The slimmer margins beside the article that phones already had now apply on any touch screen without a mouse, including iPads. With a mouse or trackpad the layout is unchanged.

entries.title: A missing PDF figure is marked, not dropped
entries.body: A PDF figure that could not be recovered used to vanish, leaving the text pointing at a diagram that was not there. Its place now says "We couldn't recover this figure from the PDF.", and if the PDF is yours you can open that page of the original. This applies to new PDFs; existing ones change only if processed again.

entries.title: The highlight button sits beside your selection
entries.body: On a touch screen, after you selected some words, the Highlight or comment button could appear at the far edge of the screen, a long way from them and easy to miss. It sits next to the selection, on whichever side has more room, and goes to the edge only when there is no space beside the words.

entries.title: Feedback's Send button stays visible while it works
entries.body: While Feedback was sending your message, the Send button faded out, so its spinner and label were hard to see and it could look as if nothing was happening. It stays at full strength while it sends, prepares an attachment or finishes a dictation, and the same goes for sending a reply.
